sources.finding: ADE for the terminal: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and more side by side, one git worktree and branch per task, sessions that outlive the terminal, web/iOS/Android/desktop/WeChat clients, machines over SSH, review with inline notes, Inbox, PR from a task, scheduled Routines, rove api for scripts and agents, plugins; MIT.

sources.title: Concepts
sources.locator: Task; Worktree and branch; Terminal Tabs; The issue store; Where things live (L1-252)
sources.finding: Managed task = worktree + branch + tabs; directory tasks reuse existing directories and need not be git repos; user-set status labels; child tasks; daemon, PTY host and TUI split; local issue store at ~/.rove/issues.json; fan out/fan in.

sources.title: Sessions: what survives what
sources.locator: What survives table (L45-62); Why: three processes
sources.finding: Quitting the TUI, SSH drop or daemon restart keep processes running; reboot or PTY-host death restores up to 64MB scrollback and relaunches the command; sleep is not detach; Rove does not keep a sleeping host awake.

sources.title: Engines
sources.locator: Which engines are supported (L16-37); Contrib engines; Picking an engine
sources.finding: Built-in claude, codex, copilot, kimi, pi, omp, bob; contrib catalog of 15 more CLIs (launch plus screen badge); custom engines and plugin engines; per-task model and effort in the engine's own flags; Claude/Codex quota probes.

sources.title: Machines
sources.locator: What this needs; Add a machine
sources.finding: Register other machines running Rove with rove machine add over SSH; no ports opened, SSH forwards the daemon unix socket; offers to install Rove and create a key on the remote.

sources.title: Orchestrating many agents
sources.locator: Task, shared child, or split; Fan out; Read context (L1-120)
sources.finding: Fan-out rounds with --count/--agents (cap 10 from shell, 5 from TUI), dispatcher/worker report and peer messages, collect, land; context read derives working/waiting/landing groups; git stash caveat.

sources.title: Routines
sources.finding: Daemon-owned cron prompts that create a normal task per run; prechecks, script routines, standing session, signed-webhook trigger; schedules use the daemon host timezone; no per-run cost attribution.

sources.title: Web client
sources.locator: What it does today; Security; Sign-in modes; Notifications when the page is closed; Limits
sources.finding: rove --web serves the same daemon state in a browser; device tokens, password, relay presets, Web Push, home-screen install; every lost-work action logged to bridge stderr with device and address.

sources.title: Desktop app
sources.locator: Download table; What it does not do
sources.finding: Electron window that starts the installed rove --web --no-qr and loads it; DMG for Apple silicon and Intel, Windows exe (unsigned) and Linux AppImage; does not bundle the CLI or daemon.

sources.title: iOS client
sources.locator: Start the bridge; Pair the phone; Pending iOS features; Not done yet (L360-379)
sources.finding: SwiftUI remote control over rove-bridge (Tailscale, Cloudflare Access presets); local notifications only while the app runs; TestFlight/App Store distribution and APNs not done; terminal view, not chat.

sources.title: Android client
sources.finding: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose client of bridge protocol v1: pairing, attention ordering, terminal tabs, diffs, new tasks, land/delete; built from source with release signing via env variables.

sources.title: Rove mobile apps privacy policy
sources.locator: Data received by Rove developers; Permissions
sources.finding: Mobile apps have no accounts, analytics, advertising or crash reporting and talk only to the user's own bridge; no push service.

sources.title: Local work tracking
sources.finding: No external tracker; daemon-owned issue store (status open/doing/hold/done, id, title, body, created) part of the Kanban first-party mod, not installed by default; agents use rove api issue-list/create/update.

sources.title: TUI guide
sources.locator: Inbox (L238-290); Diff review (L291-318); Create a PR with the active agent (L373-389); Kanban (L595-651); GitHub Issues (L669-683); Quota in the footer (L808-818)
sources.finding: Inbox attention items and decision gates; diff review with line notes sent as one prompt; PR creation is an agent prompt running gh; Kanban board of the local issue store; read-only GitHub issues page starting tasks; Claude/Codex quota meters.

sources.title: rove api reference
sources.locator: One contract, three transports (L20-50); The orchestration loop (L122-170); lifecycle publish/land (L1967-2040); issues (L1820)
sources.finding: Scriptable verbs over CLI, daemon socket and bridge WebSocket with apiVersion envelope; send/read-output/collect/land/publish; land refuses dirty base and empty branches, merge or squash.

sources.title: Configuration
sources.locator: Experimental (L520-529); First-party mods (L493-503); Per-repo init (L688); Cloned ignored directories (L430)
sources.finding: Experimental flags (remoteProjects, autoStatus, dispatcher field notes, layerfs); Kanban and Issues mods not installed by default; per-repo .rove/init.sh and clone-dirs; update channels latest/next/nightly.

sources.title: Quick start
sources.finding: curl install script (macOS, Linux, WSL), npm/bun/npx; native Windows needs Node.js and Git for Windows with Git Bash; Bun >= 1.3.11; needs git and at least one engine CLI on PATH.

sources.title: Roadmap
sources.finding: Dated check against 0.9.282 (2026-11-09): web side panel in progress, distributed core shipped, Agent API planned (first part shipped), Cloud planned with no work started and no date.

sources.title: Workspace backends and runners
sources.finding: Design note: git-worktree, borrowed, cow-clone, remote and experimental layerfs workspace backends; checkpoints and rewind landed; dispatch to registered machines landed.

sources.title: Writing Rove plugins
sources.finding: Plugins are directories with rove-plugin.toml: panes, event handlers, commands, settings, engines and mods; nothing is sandboxed.

sources.title: Worktrees
sources.finding: Per-turn checkpoints as git refs (newest 100 per task), checkpoint-list, checkpoint and rewind verbs, only for managed task worktrees.

sources.title: rove-web package manifest
sources.finding: Web client built with React, react-dom and xterm.js (webgl, fit, serialize addons).

sources.title: PR status monitor
sources.locator: gh pr view fields; checkStateFromRollup (L21, L102)
sources.finding: Reads number, url, state, reviewDecision, mergeable and statusCheckRollup through gh and reduces CI checks to a check state shown on tasks.

sources.title: Derived task group
sources.finding: Derives waiting-on-you/working/ready groups from engine state, including rate_limited with auto-resume.

sources.title: Claude quota probe
sources.finding: Reads the user's Claude OAuth usage endpoint (api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage) to show subscription windows and arm auto-resume.

sources.title: Update check
sources.finding: Update check fetches the npm registry dist-tag and GitHub release notes; no other first-party endpoint found.

sources.title: agent-turns handler
sources.finding: Sums per-turn input and output tokens from the vendor transcript for a task; no currency conversion.

sources.title: Parallel round planner
sources.finding: A parallel round larger than the fan-out cap is refused with a spawn-in-batches message.

sources.title: Experimental LayerFS backend
sources.finding: Experimental layerfs backend (Linux Runners): task files live in a FUSE-mounted LayerFS workspace run through docker exec; enabled only by experimental.layerfs in state.json.

sources.title: Cloudflare Access verification
sources.finding: Bridge verifies a Cloudflare Access JWT (signature, issuer, AUD, expiry) for the cf preset; SSO happens at Cloudflare, not in Rove.

sources.title: Routine verbs
sources.finding: routine-create accepts --webhook: signed POST to /hooks/routines/<id> (X-Hub-Signature-256) fires the routine with a generated secret.

sources.title: Issue board bucketing
sources.finding: Board columns derive from the issue lifecycle (open/doing/hold/done) and a task link set with issue-update --task.

sources.title: Decision gates
sources.finding: An agent raises a decision gate that appears in the owner's Inbox as decision_needed with options; the answer is delivered with the next send.

sources.title: Remote workspace MCP/hooks
sources.finding: Internal stdio MCP server and hooks so an engine on the hub reads, writes and edits files on a remote machine's worktree.

sources.title: Claude Code plugin and skill
sources.finding: rove skill install places a bundled skill and Claude Code hooks so a coding agent can drive rove api.

sources.title: GitHub repository API
sources.finding: Public repository Sma1lboy/rove: 188 stars, MIT license, pushed 2026-11-17 (observed 2026-11-17).

sources.title: Rove v0.9.297 release
sources.finding: Stable release v0.9.297 published 2026-11-16 at commit 4a510ee; newer -next prereleases are published for every merge to main.

sources.title: Bounded search: editor extensions
sources.locator: ls packages; grep -rniE "vscode|jetbrains|vs code extension" docs packages (excluding node_modules)
sources.finding: Packages are rove, rove-daemon, rove-bridge, rove-web, rove-desktop, rove-ios, rove-android, rove-weixin, rove-plugin-sdk, rove-harness, rove-docs, rove-landing, branding and promo-kit; no VS Code or JetBrains extension package and no docs mention one.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost and spend
sources.finding: No currency cost, budget or spend implementation; token counts exist in handlers-agent-turns.ts and daemon-runtime.ts; quota windows are shown for Claude and Codex only.

sources.title: Bounded search: roles, SSO, shared users
sources.finding: Only cf-access.ts (Cloudflare Access JWT) matches; no accounts, organizations, roles, invitations or presence implementation. Auth is a device token or password per bridge.

sources.title: Bounded search: run limits
sources.finding: No turn, token or spend limit for agent runs; only the fan-out cap, routine run limits and connect timeouts.

sources.title: Bounded search: dependencies and blockers between tasks
sources.finding: No task or issue dependency model; relationships are parent/child (dispatcher, child tasks) only.

sources.title: Bounded search: living specifications
sources.locator: grep -rniE "living spec|spec-driven|requirements doc|acceptance criteria" packages/rove*/src docs
sources.finding: No persistent product specification, acceptance criteria or drift check; the daemon issue store has title, body and status only.

sources.title: Deletion audit and bridge stderr log
sources.finding: Daemon records task deletions and the bridge writes destructive actions with device and time to stderr; no general attributed activity history, export or integrity model.

sources.title: Routines: run states, failures and retries
sources.finding: A connection drop or provider 5xx during a routine turn does not stop the routine: the next scheduled firing is the retry; any other failure holds the next firing until dismissed. Status skipped_blocked covers a task that cannot use a tick, including a turn still running.

sources.title: Routines: delivery and occurrence claims
sources.finding: The runner persists an occurrence claim before delivery so overlapping ticks and a daemon restart cannot deliver one scheduled occurrence twice; at most once, with a crash limitation; restart does not retry a claimed occurrence.

sources.title: rove api interrupt verb
sources.finding: interrupt stops the turn a task engine is running, as the headless twin of the engine interrupt key; the session, conversation and worktree survive, unlike tab-close and delete.

sources.title: Machines: --machine auto placement
sources.finding: --machine auto picks the machine with the lowest load per core among machines that have the repo; each machine reports its own load, system, cores and memory in rove daemon status; this machine keeps the work unless another is lower by more than 0.25.

sources.title: MachineLoad reading
sources.finding: A machine reports platform, arch, core count, total and free memory and 1-minute load average per core (absent on Windows) to a hub placing work with --machine auto.

sources.title: Per-tab prompt queue
sources.finding: rove api send --queue holds follow-up prompts for a busy engine tab and pastes each when the turn ends; the queue is in memory only and a daemon restart empties it.

sources.title: Issue store writes
sources.locator: imports and Issue interface (L1-60); serialized writes (L239-322)
sources.finding: Issue records hold id, title, status, created, body and an optional task link; every mutation runs inside serialized(path) and is written atomically by the single daemon; no revision, version or conflict-report field exists (grep -nE "version|rev\b|ifMatch|etag" issues-store.ts finds none).

sources.title: Reviewer search: compute limits and checks
sources.finding: Only machine placement load reading (machine-load.ts), per-worktree probe concurrency (PROBE_CONCURRENCY) and the fan-out cap match; docs/design/tasks.md says there is no automatic concurrency cap; no CPU or RAM limit, host-wide queue, fairness policy or shared limit across epics found.

sources.title: Reviewer search: indexing and retrieval
sources.finding: No repository index, vector store or retrieval API; the only relevant hit is docs/design/dispatcher.md stating field notes use full injection with no retrieval layer and no embeddings.

sources.title: Reviewer search: services, ports and secrets
sources.finding: Only ROVE_VISUAL_PORT_BASE in docs/HARNESS.md, a ports setting of the maintainers' own screenshot harness; no service orchestration, port allocation or collision handling for task workspaces. docs/design/workspace-runner.md says secrets are configured per runner and never shipped by the hub.

sources.title: Reviewer search: recordings and galleries
sources.finding: No product recording or artifact gallery; matches are theme cards, voice dictation state and the maintainers' asciicast harness in rove-harness.
